head: 1476f388e1f2134494712d9a9482e8d747735f5f
summary:
I re-checked the tree at 1476f38, which is build attempt 2 since my last pass at da3d80f. That build changed tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 and added 8 repro tests and a root-spelling corpus. It changed no product code.

**Tests**
- The 8 repro tests for O-043 to O-050 and the 3 root-spelling corpus tests: 11 of 11 passed.
- The wider set (W001*, W002*, W003*, helpers, architecture-rule twins, OptInTraitTests, and the flaky UnfinishedTests test run on its own): 88 of 88 passed.
- The full suite: 1258 of 1260. Both failures are not this slice's:
  - AppArgumentTests trips only on the engine's .taad-scratch sandbox task.ps1 files (lesson #889).
  - UnfinishedTests.StopsInTheSizeChecks… (workers: 4) is the same flaky test build-check saw before any slice code. It passes on its own.
- Fitness: every rule holds. The docs/proof-runs rule matches no file yet, as it should until a record is committed.
- Q-010: `git grep -i taad` over WindowCases.ps1 prints nothing.
- SL-107-RecordPathRule.Tests: all checks held.

**On this PC, non-elevated**
- The SUBST end-to-end script held. The record went to docs/proof-runs/w001-x-drive.json with the coverage figures. The stopped run was partial at 17,702 folders with sized '-', and held. `git status -- .taad docs` was the same before and after the run.
- W-001 -Stopped on the real C:\ProgramData, spelled 'C:/ProgramData/' to exercise the new root reading:
  - It was classed as a folder and written to artifacts.
  - 481 code-5 rows, all still refused, none refused with another code, no reason/code mismatch.
  - The stopped run stopped at 3,378 folders with sized '-'. Its 478 rows were all in the finished run's tab, none cut short.
  - Kernel pool moved by +2 MB.
- W-002 real mode on a forward-slash temp root listed 2 files. The listing failure O-050 describes would have given 0 here. It ended inconclusive, as designed for a folder with no online-only files. I removed the record it wrote.

**In Windows Sandbox, as a new standard user at Medium integrity, on the changed code**
- W-002 on the CfProvider rig held: 5 files online-only before and 5 after, 0 hydrated, 0 fetches, and the sync root was gone afterwards.
- W-003 on the SMB stall rig held: 6,137 ms from Stop to the stopped ending, no row for a folder Stop cut short, and 0 SMB mappings left.
- W-001 -Root 'C:/' -Stopped on the Sandbox's whole C:\:
  - The 'C:/' spelling was read correctly: local letter, whole drive, layer-store precaution on, record at docs/proof-runs/w001-c-drive.json.
  - The stopped part held: 82 of 82 rows matched, partial at 79,630 folders.
  - The finished part FAILED, correctly, for the same reason as on da3d80f: the Sandbox's report has no coverage and no panel, which comes from product code this slice did not change.
  - The record guard stayed quiet over that record.

**Criteria and obligations**
- All 14 design criteria are met. For 14, I re-ran the record-path corpus test but not the rules harness: no Python here has yaml, and eng/ is unchanged since build 1, where it passed.
- The fixes for O-038 and O-043 to O-050 are confirmed in the tree.
- C1b, C3, C5, C8 and C9 remain the maintainer's runs.
- Build 2 changed tests only. The design rules out product-code changes, so that is progress and not a loop.

criteria.how: On the SUBST drive: 'the coverage panel figures are in the record, with where the panel stands'. On the Sandbox's whole C:/, whose report had no coverage, the case failed with 'the report carries no coverage; the coverage panel is not on screen', so the figures really are required.

criteria.how: W001ProofTests.AStoppedRowIsPutInOneOfTheSixClasses and AStoppedRunsVerdictFollowsTheClasses passed (in the 88-test run). The real pairs all landed in 'the same', with 0 in any other class.

criteria.criterion: 6. Show that a row's code is the code of the call that failed (C4): a code-5 row whose folder now answers 32
criteria.how: The W001OracleTests corpus (F17, F18) and ARowRefusedWithAnotherCodeFailsTheRun passed. On real data, refusedAnotherCode was 0 over 481 C:\ProgramData rows and 81 Sandbox C:\ rows. The real whole-C:\ evidence remains the maintainer's (C1b).

criteria.criterion: 8. Write a record after an expensive run (995 reason with a slash; coverage holding remainder.text)
criteria.how: EveryStringACaseWouldPutInARecordIsWritten and ACoverageRecordHoldsNoStringAndIsWritten passed. The records of the 671 s Sandbox run and the SUBST run were both written, and both are quiet under the guard.

criteria.criterion: 9. Label a record, and keep proof cases out of All
criteria.how: EveryNetworkAndLinkValueIsAcceptedByTheWriter and ProofCasesAreNeverRunByCaseAll passed. Real records were labelled w002-rig, w003-rig (rig/stall) and w002-onedrive (sync-root). W-002 without -IncludeCloud printed NOT RUN.

criteria.how: W001RootSpellingTests and the 34-row corpus, checked against LongPath.NormalizeRoot, passed. Network-letter and UNC were reached only through the stubbed driveTypeOf.

criteria.criterion: 11. Prove a scan hydrates no online-only file (CfProvider 'tree' rig)
criteria.how: Sandbox, standard user: 5 files online-only before and 5 after, 0 hydrated, 0 provider fetches from the app. The rig was unregistered and its folder gone. Verdict held.

criteria.criterion: 12. Tally hydration (still online-only, hydrated, gone, none online-only)
criteria.how: AScanIsJudgedAgainstTheOnlineOnlyFilesBeforeAndAfter passed. On a real folder spelled with '/', 2 files were listed before and after, 0 online-only, and the run ended INCONCLUSIVE as designed.

criteria.criterion: 13. Time Stop to a usable window on a share that stopped answering, keep the cut folder out (stall rig)
criteria.how: Sandbox, standard user: 6,137 ms from Stop to the stopped ending. Only rows a (5) and b (59), 0 for s, t, u or 995, Cancelled. Record w003-rig, held.

criteria.criterion: 14. Guard committed records against paths at their new place (UNC, single-backslash, forward-slash, 'path' key, whole valid record at docs/proof-runs/w001-c-drive.json)
